articles.title: I've almost entirely stopped typing on my Pixel phone after finding this feature
articles.description: Google Pixel 11 series phones have a new feature that helps fix your writing based on speech input, and cleans up your stream of consciousness.
articles.content: The latest Google Pixel phones already include Gemini AI assistance that can help you do things like clean up the copy in an e-mail, message, or document to fix grammar or spelling mistakes, even adj… [+4848 chars]
